name: Sail To Prevail
description_short: A non-profit therapeutic sailing program for children and adults with disabilities, including veterans. Sailors go out on Narragansett Bay in specially adapted 20-foot sailboats from Fort Adams State Park in Newport, RI. There is also a program at the Harvard College Boat House in Cambridge, MA.
special_needs_notes: The program is built for children and adults with disabilities and for veterans. It uses specially adapted 20-foot sailboats.
swim_waterfront_notes: Sailing takes place on Narragansett Bay from the docks at Fort Adams State Park, Newport, RI. The page gives no swim requirements or safety details.

There are no camp sessions, ages or season year, so the validator cannot pass.
